sloka: तस्यास्तद्वनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।हर्षयन् मैथिलीं वाक्यमुवाचेदं महाद्युतिः ।। ६.११६.५० ।।
transliteration: tasyāstadvanaṁ śrutvā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।harṣayan maithilīṁ vākyamuvācedaṁ mahādyutiḥ ।। 6.116.50 ।।

translations.english: "Devi! you are the righteous wife of Rama and earned fame. Give me the right message to Rama in return. I will go."
